constraints.name: travel_no_employee_review_forgery
constraints.definition: CHECK (((status <> ALL (ARRAY['draft'::text, 'submitted'::text])) OR ((reviewed_at IS NULL) AND (reviewed_by IS NULL) AND (review_note IS NULL))))

constraints.name: travel_submitted_fields_required
constraints.definition: CHECK (((status = 'draft'::text) OR ((destination IS NOT NULL) AND (from_date IS NOT NULL) AND (to_date IS NOT NULL) AND (purpose IS NOT NULL) AND (submitted_at IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: travel_valid_date_range
constraints.definition: CHECK (((from_date IS NULL) OR (to_date IS NULL) OR (to_date >= from_date)))
